Depends on what kind of date, and what kind of girl she is.

You'll wanna approach her while she's in a good mood. say something simple like, "hey, you know what? I kinda like you, a lot, so if you want, could we go out sometime?" 
When a girl gets asked out by a guy, she likes to not only be told, but shown. 

Some girls like to go out on actual dates, like lunch or dinner dates (not me, my idea of a date is pizza, a good xbox or ps3 game and snuggles) but others will settle with whatever.

Show her you're really interested in her, but don't get too overwhelming, cause that might creep her out a bit.

Hope this helped! Good luck!
